items.item_text: Associate’s degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Two (2) years of project management and/or equivalent administrative experience/training
Experience working in a healthcare and/or hospital environment.
Experience in assisting with the development and generation of monthly management reports of personnel data for review by departmental management teams.
Experience working in advanced analytics programs like Qualtrics, Tableau, Box, etc.
Analytical experience and skills to review established policies and procedures, data, and situations for conformance with established guidelines.
Experience working with UCDMC/UCDH/University programs like UCPath, AggieService, Ecotime, etc.

Under the general direction of the Administrative Services Assistant Director and Administrative Supervisor, this position provides independent project management and human resources, departmental policy and procedure creation, and analytical support for payroll for the Environmental Services Department. This Analyst plays a crucial role in collecting, structuring, analyzing, and reporting on processes and data. Responsible for independently planning and assisting with the development of departmental policies and procedures. Manage and facilitate projects, define priorities and action steps, research ideas and plans with stakeholders, draft concept papers, develop timelines and discuss budgets, and make recommendations as appropriate.
50% - Payroll Analysis, Maintenance and Records Management

Provides support to the EVS Leadership team with the processing of employee’s timecards on a biweekly and monthly basis for approximately 600 employees. This includes auditing timecards daily, making corrections, and ensuring the appropriate pay codes are used before final closing. Responsible for tracking all attendance related issues: FMLA, LOA, Tardiness, Sick, Vacation, ESL, PTOP, etc. This position will also collaborate with UCDH Payroll office to resolve any payroll issues. Assists department leadership with collecting and analyzing data for departmental bargaining including effects bargaining, grievance and arbitration meetings. Provide assistance on matters that are confidential, sensitive and complex in nature and which require a high level of analytical skill, attention to detail, independent judgment, initiative, and a high degree of professionalism. The incumbent in this position works with various levels of University management. Work involves a high degree of confidentiality.
50% - Analysis and Project Management
Computer skills to apply various software programs (Microsoft Outlook, MS Exchange, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and the Internet) to accomplish assignments.
Knowledge and understanding of campus-wide offices, administrative contacts, departments and resources.

Analytical and problem solving skills to work with complex information, determine impact, identify risks, evaluate approaches; and develop solutions within the context of priorities, time constraints, and available resources.
Knowledge and understanding of UCDMC/UCDH/University policies and procedures and Staff Personnel policies and procedures
Ability to exercise sound judgment, prioritize competing responsibilities, make decisions within established guidelines, and resolve routine problems with minimal supervisory direction.

Political acumen and collegial communication skills to interact with persons at all levels of the hierarchy with varying backgrounds, levels of expertise, interest, and personal investment. Ability to be resourceful and diplomatic in facilitating the completion of projects.
Ability to compile, analyze, and present personnel data in clear and accurate management reports to support departmental planning, decision-making, and operational objectives.

Ability to analyze and synthesize complex information, assess implications for leadership priorities, and communicate findings and recommendations effectively to executives and departmental management.
Proficient in organizing, prioritizing, and managing multiple assignments simultaneously while meeting competing deadlines and maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Skills to discern new policies or procedures and revisions of existing for utilization.
Mathematical, writing, editing and proofreading skills to produce clear, well-organized information with strict attention to correct grammar, spelling and punctuation.
Teaching and communication skills necessary for interactions with department staff and other UC employees as necessary.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate operational needs, plan proactively and initiate follow-up action.
